simple.meaning: חָזוּת (châzûwth) is a Hebrew word meaning “a look ; hence (figuratively) striking appearance , revelation , or (by implication) compact.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חָזוּת (H2380) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 21:2, with occurrences in Isaiah, Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָזוּת (H2380) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חָזוּת (H2380) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חָזוּת (châzûwth) / H2380 is traced through Isaiah 21:2, Isaiah 28:18, Isaiah 29:11, Daniel 8:5 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

structuredEvidence.definition: a look ; hence (figuratively) striking appearance , revelation , or (by implication) compact

firstOccurrence.englishText: A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.

timeline.evidenceText: A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.

Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol † Sheol is the place of the dead. shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.
All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t, for it is sealed;”
As I was considering, behold, a male goat came from the west over the surface of the whole earth, and didn’t touch the ground. The goat had a notable horn between his eyes.
The male goat magnified himself exceedingly. When he was strong, the great horn was broken; and instead of it there came up four notable horns toward the four winds of the sky.

definitions.full: H2380. chazuth חָזוּת noun feminine vision, conspicuousness (on formation compare Lg BN 202 ) — absolute ׳ח Isa 21:2 ; Dan 8:5 , 8 ; construct חָזוּת Isa 29:11 ; suffix חָזוּתְכֶם 28:18 ; — 1 vision, oracle of a prophet הֻגַּדלִֿי קָשָׁה חָזוּת Isa 21:2 a hard vision is declared to me ; הֶחָתוּם הַסֵּפֶר כְּדִבְרֵי הַּכֹּל חָזוּת לָכֶם וַתְּהִי 29:11 the vision (prophecy) of the whole is become to you as the words of a sealed writing ; תָקוּם לאֹ אֶתשְֿׁאוֺל חָזוּתְכֶם 28:18 your agreement with Sheol will not stand , so Thes MV De Che Di and others after Vrss, but Ew § 156 e renders oracle , and Siegf. Hellseherei , see חֹזֶה 2. 2. conspicuousness in appearance: הָזוּת קֶרֶן a conspicuous horn Dan 8:5 +? 8:8 ; 8:21 ; so אַרְבַּע חָזוּת 8:8 , but < read אֲחֵרוֺת others , as ᵐ5 Gr Bev.
